title: CVE-2025-21298 - Windows OLE Remote Code Execution Vulnerability
content: A remote code execution vulnerability exists in Windows OLE when it fails to properly validate user-supplied data. An attacker who successfully exploited this vulnerability could run arbitrary code in the context of the current user. Exploitation of this vulnerability requires that a user open a specially crafted email with an affected version of Microsoft Outlook. The update addresses the vulnerability by modifying how Windows OLE validates user-supplied data. CVSS Score: 9.8 (Critical). Affected products: Windows 10, Windows 11, Windows Server 2019, Windows Server 2022.

title: CVE-2025-30065 Apache Parquet RCE
content: CRITICAL: CVE-2025-30065 - Apache Parquet Java library Remote Code Execution. CVSS 10.0. Schema parsing in parquet-avro allows arbitrary code execution when reading a crafted Parquet file. All versions <= 1.15.0 affected. Patch: upgrade to 1.15.1. Impact: any system reading untrusted Parquet files (data pipelines, ML platforms, Hadoop clusters). PoC available on GitHub.

title: New ransomware campaign targeting Nginx servers
content: We're observing a new ransomware campaign targeting exposed Nginx web servers via CVE-2024-38473 (Apache HTTP server path traversal - actors pivoting to co-hosted Nginx). C2: 185.220.101.45, 193.142.147.65. Dropper hash (SHA256): e3b0c44298fc1c149afbf4c8996fb92427ae41e4649b934ca495991b7852b855. IOCs being shared across dark web forums. Organizations using Nginx on AWS should patch immediately.

title: CVE-2025-0282 - Ivanti Connect Secure Stack-Based Buffer Overflow
content: Ivanti Connect Secure, Policy Secure, and ZTA Gateways contain a stack-based buffer overflow vulnerability that allows a remote unauthenticated attacker to achieve remote code execution. This vulnerability has been added to CISA KEV as it is being actively exploited in the wild. Affected versions: Connect Secure 22.7R2.4 and prior, Policy Secure 22.7R1.2 and prior. Mitigation: Apply vendor patches immediately. Due date: 2025-04-05.

title: PostgreSQL authentication bypass - CVE-2025-1094
content: Heads up everyone - CVE-2025-1094 is a SQL injection via invalid Unicode in PostgreSQL libpq that can bypass authentication. Affects PostgreSQL 17.2 and earlier, 16.6 and earlier, 15.10 and earlier. This is being chained with BeyondTrust vulnerabilities in active exploitation. If you're running PostgreSQL on Linux with default configs, prioritize patching. Seen reports of credential dumping post-exploitation at several financial sector orgs. CVSS: 8.1 High.

title: Lazarus Group targets developers with fake job offers via LinkedIn
content: North Korean threat actor Lazarus Group is conducting a new campaign targeting software developers via LinkedIn. The group sends fake job offers and then delivers malicious coding challenges containing backdoored npm packages. Upon execution, the malware establishes persistence and exfiltrates credentials and source code. Targets include developers using React and NodeJS. The campaign has been attributed to Operation Dream Job.

title: Redis unauthenticated RCE via Lua sandbox escape
content: New Redis RCE PoC released for CVE-2025-21605 (Lua sandbox escape). Affects Redis 7.x < 7.4.2. Unauthenticated attacker on network can execute arbitrary system commands. Mass scanning observed from 45.155.204.0/24. Patch: upgrade to Redis 7.4.2 or later. Temporary workaround: rename EVAL command, restrict network access to trusted IPs only.

title: APT29 phishing campaign - credential harvesting targeting cloud platforms
content: OTX Pulse: APT29 (Cozy Bear) phishing campaign targeting AWS IAM credentials via convincing login pages hosted at 203.0.113.45. Phishing domains: aws-secure-login[.]com, iam-portal-aws[.]net. Lure: fake AWS security alert emails. SHA256 of dropper: 9f86d081884c7d659a2feaa0c55ad015a3bf4f1b2b0b822cd15d6c15b0f00a8. TTPs include T1566.002 (Spearphishing Link), T1078 (Valid Accounts).
